extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Starting line is net income available to common stockholders (the FFO section starts there, not at net income). Page marker for the FFO table reads printed=3 (text shows S-3). The 'Gains not included in FFO' line is '-' (zero) for Q1 2026. Core/FFO sums verified: 106,186 + adjustments = 278,028; 278,028 + adjustments = 270,861. Diluted shares 66,688,617 divided by 1,000 = 66,688.617 thousand; per-share check: 278,028/66,688.617 = 4.17 and 270,861/66,688.617 = 4.06. Recurring capex: ESS has no AFFO, so the Q1 2026 non-revenue generating capex of $19,639K from the Capital Expenditures table (seq 24) is recorded as the maintenance-equivalent figure; revenue generating capex ($8,694K) was not treated as recurring. Tax on tech co-investments and provision for credit losses were categorized as 'other' because no listed category fits. The 'General and administrative and other, net' line was categorized as 'other' (it includes $1.6M political advocacy costs per footnote).
